items.source: defaultExecutor - the Executor (typically a Spring AsyncTaskExecutor or ExecutorService) to delegate to, unless a more specific executor has been requested via a qualifier on the async method, in which case the executor will be looked up at invocation time against the enclosing bean factory
items.translation: defaultExecutor - 要委托的 Executor（通常是 Spring AsyncTaskExecutor 或 ExecutorService），除非通过异步方法上的限定符请求了更具体的执行器，在这种情况下，将在调用时从外围 Bean 工厂中查找该执行器。

items.source: Supply the AsyncUncaughtExceptionHandler to use to handle exceptions thrown by invoking asynchronous methods with a void return type.
items.translation: 提供 `AsyncUncaughtExceptionHandler` 来处理通过调用返回类型为 `void` 的异步方法时抛出的异常。

items.source: Create a new instance with a default AsyncUncaughtExceptionHandler.
items.translation: 创建一个带有默认 AsyncUncaughtExceptionHandler 的新实例。

items.source: Create a new AsyncExecutionAspectSupport with the given exception handler.
items.translation: 创建一个新的带有给定异常处理器的AsyncExecutionAspectSupport。

items.source: Set the BeanFactory to be used when looking up executors by qualifier or when relying on the default executor lookup algorithm.
items.translation: 将 `BeanFactory` 设置为通过限定符查找执行器或依赖默认执行器查找算法时使用的工厂。

items.source: The default implementation searches for a unique TaskExecutor bean in the context, or for an Executor bean named "taskExecutor" otherwise. If neither of the two is resolvable, this implementation will return null.
items.translation: 默认实现会在上下文中搜索唯一的TaskExecutorBean，否则将搜索名为 "taskExecutor" 的ExecutorBean。如果这两种情况都无法解析，此实现将返回null。

items.source: Provides support for executor qualification on a method-by-method basis. AsyncExecutionAspectSupport objects must be constructed with a default Executor, but each individual method may further qualify a specific Executor bean to be used when executing it, for example, through an annotation attribute.
items.translation: 支持按方法级别进行执行器资格认证。必须使用默认 Executor 构造 AsyncExecutionAspectSupport 对象，但每个单独的方法可以进一步指定用于执行特定 Executor Bean 的实例，例如通过注解属性。

items.source: If the return type of the method is a Future object, the original exception can be propagated by just throwing it at the higher level. However, for all other cases, the exception will not be transmitted back to the client. In that later case, the current AsyncUncaughtExceptionHandler will be used to manage such exception.
items.translation: 如果方法的返回类型是 `Future` 对象，则可以通过在更高层抛出原始异常来传播该异常。然而，对于所有其他情况，异常将不会传输回客户端。在后一种情况下，当前的 `AsyncUncaughtExceptionHandler` 将被用于管理此类异常。

items.source: Returning an empty string or null indicates that no specific executor has been specified and that the default executor should be used.
items.translation: 返回空字符串或 `null` 表示未指定特定的执行器，应使用默认执行器。

items.source:
Note that the initial lookup happens by type; this is just the fallback
in case of multiple executor beans found in the context.
items.translation: 注意，初始查找是按类型进行的；这只是在上下文中找到多个执行器 Bean 时的后备方案。

items.source: An executor returned from here will be cached for further use.
items.translation: 从此处返回的 Executor 将被缓存以供后续使用。

items.source: The default name of the TaskExecutor bean to pick up: "taskExecutor".
items.translation: 默认要拾取的 `TaskExecutor` bean 的名称为："taskExecutor"。

items.source:
Configure this aspect with the given executor and exception handler suppliers,
applying the corresponding default if a supplier is not resolvable.
items.translation: 使用给定的执行器和异常处理器供应商配置此方面，如果无法解析供应商则应用相应的默认值。

items.source: Determine the specific executor to use when executing the given method.
items.translation: 确定执行给定方法时使用的具体执行器。

items.source: Delegate for actually executing the given task with the chosen executor.
items.translation: 用于使用所选执行器实际执行给定任务的委托。

items.source: Retrieve a target executor for the given qualifier.
items.translation: 获取给定限定符的目标执行器。

items.source: Supply the executor to be used when executing async methods.
items.translation: 提供用于执行异步方法的执行器。

items.source: Handles a fatal error thrown while asynchronously invoking the specified Method.
items.translation: 处理在异步调用指定的 Method 时抛出的致命错误。

items.source: Retrieve or build a default executor for this advice instance.
items.translation: 为此建议实例检索或构建默认执行器。

items.source:
Return the qualifier or bean name of the executor to be used when executing the
given async method, typically specified in the form of an annotation attribute.
items.translation: 返回用于执行给定异步方法的执行器的限定符或 Bean 名称，通常以注解属性的形式指定。
